Python is the only one in her shipped list, which falls below the 2-match threshold. Her shipped stack (PyTorch, Hugging Face Transformers, sentence-transformers, FastAPI, MLflow, PostgreSQL, AWS, SQL) does not overlap with the IT administration requirements. (4) Level: No 3+ years or PhD requirement is stated, but the posting asks for hands-on IT support experience, which she lacks; her background is an ML Engineer co-op and MS AI coursework. (5) Sponsorship: Anthropic says 'We do sponsor visas!', so sponsorship is not a blocker, and she needs it. The role type, location and skills failures each make the posting NOT_RELEVANT on their own.
